title: クリスマスの塗り絵
subject_en: Coloring pages of Christmas items, each ONE big simple object or scene, centred, drawn with thick, clean, closed black outlines only and NOTHING filled in: the inside of every shape stays plain white. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: ツリー・サンタ・トナカイ・ケーキなど、クリスマスの塗り絵12点です。家庭や教室の制作活動、季節のお知らせに使えます。
items: a decorated Christmas tree with a star, balls and gifts
a smiling Santa Claus standing with a sack
a cute reindeer with big antlers and a bell
a Christmas boot filled with candy and small gifts
a round Christmas cake with strawberries and a small Santa
a Christmas wreath with a ribbon and pinecones
a snowman with a scarf and a bucket hat
three stacked gift boxes with ribbons
two jingle bells with holly and a ribbon
a small angel with wings and a trumpet
a cozy house with snow on the roof and a chimney
